title: The Spa Trail
description: Explore a walking and cycling route along the former railway. Read the route guide for access points, surfaces and current notices.

title: Woodhall Spa Heritage Trail
description: Discover the village through its heritage trail. Use the route guide to plan your walk and learn about local landmarks.

title: Woodhall Spa Short Mat Bowls
description: Try an afternoon of indoor short mat bowls. Contact the club before your first visit to confirm participation, equipment and charges.

title: Viking Way Short Walk
description: A 2.5-mile village circuit starting at the Cottage Museum. Mixed paths pass woodland and cross the golf course; follow signs and watch for play.

title: Viking Way Long Walk
description: A six-mile countryside circuit taking in village paths, woodland and the River Witham. Expect uneven ground, gates and road sections; use the route map.

title: Water Rail Way
description: Walk or cycle beside the River Witham on this shared trail. Kirkstead provides local access. Choose a suitable section and check current route information.

title: The Viking Way
description: Discover a long-distance walking trail through Lincolnshire. Plan a manageable section using the route guide rather than attempting the whole trail from Woodhall Spa.

title: Woodhall Spa Airfield Nature Reserve
description: Explore wildlife habitats on a former RAF airfield. Arrange the current access code with Lincolnshire Wildlife Trust before travelling. Assistance dogs only.

title: Roughton Moor Wood
description: Discover a woodland reserve with waymarked paths and seasonal wildlife. Ground can be uneven or muddy. Check the Wildlife Trust access guidance; assistance dogs only.

title: Wolds Wildlife Park
description: See big cats, bears and other animals near Horncastle. Check seasonal opening and ticket arrangements before making a special journey.

title: The Bubblecar Museum
description: Explore microcars and motoring memorabilia at this unusual museum. Opening is seasonal, and special ride days need checking with the museum.

title: Cadwell Park
description: Plan a motorsport day around the circuit’s published calendar. Choose an event and confirm tickets, access and spectator arrangements before travelling.

title: Lincolnshire Wildlife Park
description: Discover rescued animals, parrots and big cats. Use the park’s visitor guide to check admission, facilities and seasonal information.

title: Gunby Estate, Hall & Gardens
description: Explore a country house, gardens and estate walks. House and garden opening differ, so check the National Trust timetable before setting off.

title: Tattershall Kart Centre
description: An outdoor karting option for families and groups. Telephone 01526 344566 to arrange a session and confirm driver requirements, prices and weather arrangements.

title: Lincoln Cathedral
description: Visit Lincoln’s cathedral and its historic surroundings. Check visitor access, services and admission arrangements when planning your day.

title: Beginners Crochet · Morning
description: A beginner crochet workshop at Fairy Crafters. Listed at £25 per person. Check remaining places and book through the organiser.

title: Beginners Crochet · Evening
description: A beginner crochet workshop at Fairy Crafters. Listed at £25 per person. Check remaining places and book through the organiser.

title: Active Explorers · 27 October
description: Activity morning for ages 5–11. Booking and guardian consent are required. Check swimming eligibility, what to bring and collection arrangements with Jubilee Park.

title: Active Explorers · 29 October
description: Activity morning for ages 5–11. Booking and guardian consent are required. Check swimming eligibility, what to bring and collection arrangements with Jubilee Park.

title: Christmas Decorations Workshop
description: Make porcelain decorations at Potty Time Pottery. Listed at £45 inclusive. Contact the organiser to check availability and reserve a place.

title: Christmas Snowman Workshop
description: Create a ceramic snowman at Potty Time Pottery. Listed at £45 inclusive. Ask the organiser about booking, availability and workshop arrangements.
